scope: Source MJCF entrypoints, not expanded include/mesh/texture closure, independent layouts, houses or generated scene configurations.

counting_policy.entrypoint: One source file can support several tasks; paths and content hashes are both retained.
counting_policy.layout: Task-relevant fixture/navigation topology; pose jitter, renamed XML, camera or style alone does not add a layout.
counting_policy.style: Versioned coherent visual asset/material set; color seeds are variants, not automatically independent styles.
counting_policy.configuration: Only compatible, instantiated and validated layout/style combinations count; do not use the unverified Cartesian product.
counting_policy.initial_state: G3 also includes task, object state and robot state, and is not a new scene asset.
